# Glenhold Bookkeeping

> Glenhold Bookkeeping is a Simi Valley-based bookkeeping firm owned by Jack and operated by Glenhold Advisory LLC. It serves small businesses of every kind within about an hour of Simi Valley, California. Monthly bookkeeping starts at $349, $599, and $1,499. Love your first month of books, or it is free.

## Facts

- Legal entity: Glenhold Advisory LLC, doing business as Glenhold Bookkeeping
- Owner: Jack, former Big 4 accountant and Certified QuickBooks ProAdvisor
- You work directly with Jack
- Base: Simi Valley, California. No street address is published. No walk-in office
- Phone: (805) 419-3451
- Email: jack@glenhold.com
- Website: https://glenhold.com/
- Hours: Monday through Saturday, 6:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
- Service model: remote bookkeeping, with in-person meetings by arrangement in the service area
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@BookkeepingWithJack
- Not offered: tax return preparation, sales-tax filing, running payroll, audits or reviews, trust-account compliance
- QuickBooks Online subscription is billed by Intuit and is not included in Glenhold's prices
- QuickBooks Desktop is not a published service
- Guarantee: love your first month of monthly books, or that month is free

## Prices

- Essential monthly bookkeeping: starting at $349 per month. Categorization, reconciliation, monthly statements, clean books for tax season
- Core monthly bookkeeping: starting at $599 per month. Essential, plus a quarterly profit and expense summary, year-to-date comparison, and priority support
- Strategic monthly bookkeeping: starting at $1,499 per month. Core, plus custom reports, accrual accounting, payroll journal entries, loan tracking, and a monthly call
- Cleanup, catch-up, consulting, and training are quoted separately
- Quotes move with transaction volume, number of accounts, and reporting complexity
- No city surcharge is published

## California notes, general only

- Most California LLCs owe an annual minimum franchise tax of $800. A first-year waiver applied only to LLCs that registered in 2021, 2022, or 2023. Glenhold does not file it
- Sole proprietors do not pay that LLC tax
- An additional LLC fee can apply based on total income, historically starting at $250,000. Confirm current tiers with the Franchise Tax Board or a CPA
- California statewide base sales and use tax is 7.25 percent. District taxes add more and change. Glenhold records tax collected as a liability and does not file the return

## FAQ answers

### What is Glenhold Bookkeeping?

Glenhold Bookkeeping is a Simi Valley-based bookkeeping firm owned by Jack and operated by Glenhold Advisory LLC. It provides monthly bookkeeping, cleanup and catch-up, and QuickBooks Online setup and training for small businesses of every kind. The phone number is (805) 419-3451 and the email is jack@glenhold.com.

### Who owns Glenhold Bookkeeping?

Jack owns Glenhold Bookkeeping and is the person you work with. He is a Simi Valley local, a former Big 4 accountant, and a Certified QuickBooks ProAdvisor. The legal entity is Glenhold Advisory LLC.

### Is Glenhold Bookkeeping the same as Glenhold Advisory LLC?

Yes. Glenhold Advisory LLC is the legal entity. Glenhold Bookkeeping is the name it uses with clients. The phone is (805) 419-3451, the email is jack@glenhold.com, and the website is glenhold.com.

### Where is Glenhold Bookkeeping based?

Glenhold Bookkeeping is based in Simi Valley, California. It is a service-area business. The site does not publish a street address, and there is no walk-in office. The service area is roughly an hour's drive from Simi Valley, traffic permitting, across nearby Ventura County and Los Angeles communities.

### What are Glenhold Bookkeeping's hours?

Glenhold Bookkeeping's hours are Monday through Saturday, 6am to 6pm Pacific Time. Sunday is not listed as an open day. Messages sent through the site get a reply within one business day.

### Is Jack a CPA?

This site does not list a CPA license for Jack. It lists him as the owner of Glenhold Bookkeeping, a former Big 4 accountant, and a Certified QuickBooks ProAdvisor. Big 4 experience is not the same thing as a current CPA license. Tax returns and tax advice stay with a CPA or other tax preparer you choose.

### Do you only work with certain industries?

No. Glenhold works with small businesses across industries. The scope is based on your accounts, bookkeeping needs, and reporting goals rather than a single industry specialty.

### Will I work directly with the owner?

Yes. You work directly with Jack, the founder of Glenhold Bookkeeping, a Simi Valley local, former Big 4 accountant, and Certified QuickBooks ProAdvisor.

### How much does Glenhold bookkeeping cost?

Monthly bookkeeping plans start at $349 for Essential, $599 for Core, and $1,499 for Strategic. These are starting prices; the quote depends on the volume and complexity of the work. Cleanup, catch-up, consulting, and training are scoped separately.

### How much does bookkeeping cost in Ventura County?

Glenhold Bookkeeping is a Simi Valley-based bookkeeping firm serving Ventura County, and its monthly plans start at $349, $599, and $1,499. Those are Glenhold's starting prices, not a survey of every bookkeeper in the county. Cleanup and QuickBooks training are quoted separately. The quote depends on transaction volume, the number of accounts, and reporting complexity.

### How much does bookkeeping cost in the Los Angeles area near Simi Valley?

For Los Angeles neighborhoods within about an hour of Simi Valley, Glenhold Bookkeeping uses the same starting prices published for Ventura County: $349, $599, and $1,499 a month. The site does not add a city surcharge. The quote still depends on the work. This site does not publish an average Los Angeles bookkeeping rate.

### What is included in Essential bookkeeping at $349 a month?

Essential starts at $349 a month for small businesses with simple accounting needs that want clean books at tax time. It includes expense categorization, monthly bank and credit card reconciliation, monthly financial statements, and clean books for tax season. It does not include Core's quarterly summary, year-to-date comparison, or priority support.

### What is included in Core bookkeeping at $599 a month?

Core starts at $599 a month. It includes everything in Essential, plus a quarterly profit and expense summary, a year-to-date performance comparison, and priority support. It is for growing businesses that want a clearer picture of performance, not only a file for tax season.

### What is included in Strategic bookkeeping at $1,499 a month?

Strategic starts at $1,499 a month. It includes everything in Core, plus custom financial reports, accrual accounting, payroll journal entries, loan tracking, and a monthly call to walk through your numbers. It is for established businesses that want a closer monthly review. Like the other plans, $1,499 is a starting price.

### Why isn't small-business bookkeeping one flat price?

Two businesses can both be small and need very different time. One checking account and a modest number of transactions is not the same job as several cards, loans, payroll entries, and a high sales volume. Glenhold's published prices are starting points. The quote moves with transaction volume, the number of accounts, and reporting complexity.

### Does the monthly bookkeeping price include QuickBooks Online?

No. The Essential, Core, and Strategic prices are for Glenhold's bookkeeping work. A QuickBooks Online subscription is billed by Intuit, not included in the prices on this site. Intuit's price depends on the version and changes, so check the current price with Intuit.

### What does the first-month bookkeeping guarantee cover?

Love your first month of books, or it's free. The guarantee applies to the first month of monthly bookkeeping. Cleanup, catch-up, consulting, and training are scoped separately, and the monthly starting prices are not a quote for that work. The QuickBooks subscription is also separate.

### How much does catch-up bookkeeping cost?

Catch-up and cleanup are quoted from the number of months, accounts, transactions, and corrections, not from the $349, $599, or $1,499 monthly starting prices. A short gap with complete statements is a different project from several years of unreconciled accounts. Jack scopes the work before you agree to it.

### What does monthly bookkeeping include?

All monthly plans include expense categorization, monthly bank and credit card reconciliation, monthly financial statements, and clean books for tax season. Core adds a quarterly profit and expense summary, a year-to-date performance comparison, and priority support. Strategic adds custom financial reports, accrual accounting, payroll journal entries, loan tracking, and a monthly call to walk through your numbers.

### When are monthly financial statements ready?

Monthly bookkeeping targets a profit and loss and a balance sheet by the 15th of the following month. That timing depends on statements and answers arriving in time to reconcile. If a statement is late, the close can slip. All three monthly plans include these statements.

### What is a profit and loss statement?

A profit and loss statement shows income, expenses, and the profit or loss for a period, usually a month or a year. It does not, by itself, show how much cash is in the bank. Glenhold's monthly plans include a profit and loss, with a target of the 15th for the prior month.

### What is a balance sheet?

A balance sheet shows what the business owns, what it owes, and the owner's equity on a given date. Bank balances, credit cards, loans, and owner draws affect it. Glenhold's monthly plans include a balance sheet along with the profit and loss.

### What is a bank reconciliation?

A bank or credit card reconciliation checks the balance in the books against the statement. Statement lines should match book entries, including fees, interest, and transfers. When it ties, that account can be closed for the month. When it does not, something is missing, duplicated, or in the wrong account. Every Glenhold monthly plan includes this work.

### Does Glenhold process payroll?

No. Glenhold does not run payroll and does not file payroll tax returns. Strategic bookkeeping includes payroll journal entries so totals from your payroll provider can be recorded in the books. Running payroll stays with your payroll company.

### Can I switch between Essential, Core, and Strategic?

Yes. The plans are levels of support, and you can adjust as you grow. A move is a scope change, usually because volume, accounts, or reporting needs changed. Ask before the next close rather than assuming a mid-month switch.

### Can you help if my books are months or years behind?

Yes. Cleanup and catch-up services can cover unfinished periods, transaction classification, imports from statements and exports, reconciliation, and a clean handoff to your CPA. The scope and timeline depend on the records available and the work required.

### What is the difference between bookkeeping cleanup and catch-up?

Cleanup means correcting books that already exist: duplicates, wrong categories, and balances that do not match the bank. Catch-up means recording periods that were never finished. Many projects are both. Glenhold does either, for periods you still have records for, and can hand the result to your CPA.

### What records do you need for catch-up bookkeeping?

Start with the months that need work, every business bank and credit card account including accounts you closed, and statements that show opening and closing balances. Add loan statements, payroll reports, and a note of money you put in or took out if those apply. If you changed banks, include both accounts. Ask how to share files before you send sensitive documents.

### How long does catch-up bookkeeping take?

It depends on the size of the backlog, missing statements, and how quickly open questions get answered. A short gap with complete statements moves faster than several years with closed accounts and no opening balance. Tell Jack about any tax or lender deadline on the first call. The site does not promise a fixed number of days.

### Will catch-up bookkeeping make my books ready for a CPA?

That is the point of a cleanup handoff. You get classified transactions, reconciled accounts, and financial statements, plus a note of anything the records could not support. Your CPA uses that package for the return. Glenhold does not file the tax return.

### Can bookkeeping cleanup prepare numbers a lender can review?

Lenders often ask for a profit and loss, a balance sheet, and recent bank statements. Glenhold can catch up and reconcile the books and produce those financial statements. That is not a loan application and it is not an approval. The lender may still ask your CPA for tax returns.

### Can you help with QuickBooks Online?

Yes. Glenhold offers QuickBooks Online setup, chart of accounts organization, consulting, training, and accuracy check-ins. Jack is a Certified QuickBooks ProAdvisor. You can discuss full monthly bookkeeping if you later want ongoing support.

### What happens in a QuickBooks Online setup?

Setup starts with how money moves through the business and which reports you need. Jack sets up the QuickBooks Online file, builds a chart of accounts around your operations, and walks through a routine for reviewing activity, separating transfers from income and expenses, and reconciling. Setup is scoped separately from the monthly plans.

### What is a chart of accounts?

The chart of accounts is the list of categories in the books: income, expenses, assets, liabilities, and equity. A useful chart matches how the business operates. Too many overlapping accounts make a profit and loss hard to read. Too few hide what you wanted to see. Glenhold builds or revises the chart during setup, cleanup, or monthly work.

### Can Glenhold train me to keep my own books?

Yes. Consulting and training are for owners who want to keep doing the work and want setup help, a cleaner chart of accounts, or accuracy check-ins on an agreed schedule. The training follows the tasks you actually do. It is scoped separately from monthly bookkeeping.

### Do you support QuickBooks Desktop?

The setup, training, and consulting described on this site are for QuickBooks Online. QuickBooks Desktop is not a published Glenhold service. If your file is still on Desktop, say so on the intro call before any work is scoped.

### What is the difference between a bookkeeper and a CPA?

A bookkeeper records transactions, reconciles bank and credit card accounts, and prepares financial statements. A CPA is a licensed accountant who can prepare and sign tax returns, give tax advice, and, when engaged for it, perform audits or reviews. Glenhold Bookkeeping does the bookkeeping. Tax filing stays with your CPA or other tax preparer.

### Do I need a bookkeeper if I already have a CPA?

Often, yes. A CPA closing a year of unsorted transactions is doing bookkeeping under time pressure. A bookkeeper keeps the months current so the CPA can prepare the return from reconciled statements. Glenhold's work is built for that handoff. Hiring Glenhold does not replace your tax preparer.

### Does bookkeeping include filing my tax return?

The listed services focus on bookkeeping and preparing organized records for tax season. Tax return preparation and filing are separate from the bookkeeping services described here; coordinate those with your CPA or tax preparer.

### What does clean books for tax season mean?

It means the accounts are categorized, bank and card accounts are reconciled, and the profit and loss and balance sheet are ready to hand to your tax preparer. It does not mean the tax return has been prepared or filed. Your CPA still reviews the books and files the return.

### Can a bookkeeper give tax advice?

Glenhold does not offer tax advice or tax return preparation. Questions about deductions, entity choice, and what a payment should be called for tax purposes belong with your CPA or other tax preparer. Jack will record payments in the account you and your preparer agree on rather than guess at a tax position.

### Why does a small-business bookkeeper mention Big 4 experience?

Jack started his career at a Big 4 firm, including work on large company books and audits of Fortune 500 financial services companies. At Glenhold that background shows up as a chart of accounts that matches the business, reconciliations that tie to statements, and reports an owner can read. Glenhold does not offer audit or attestation services.

### What is the California $800 LLC franchise tax?

Most California limited liability companies owe an annual minimum franchise tax of $800 to the Franchise Tax Board, including years with little or no profit. A temporary waiver of that first-year tax applied only to LLCs that organized or registered in 2021, 2022, or 2023. Glenhold does not file the franchise-tax return. Confirm whether the $800 applies to your entity, and when it is due, with your CPA or the Franchise Tax Board.

### Does every small business in California owe the $800 franchise tax?

No. The $800 minimum franchise tax applies to California LLCs and to corporations, not to a sole proprietor who has not formed one of those entities. A sole proprietor still has income tax and, if they sell taxable goods, sales tax to think about. Whether to form an LLC is a legal and tax decision. Glenhold can keep books either way.

### What is the California LLC fee on total income?

California LLCs can owe an LLC fee based on total income, separate from the $800 minimum franchise tax. The fee uses income tiers set in state law and, for many years, has started once total income reaches $250,000. Confirm the current tiers and the income definition with your CPA or the Franchise Tax Board. The books matter because the fee follows total income, not only profit.

### How should California sales tax show up in the books?

Sales tax you collect is not revenue. It is a liability until it is paid to the California Department of Tax and Fee Administration. The sale itself is income. Tax collected sits in a sales-tax payable account, and the payment reduces that account. Glenhold can record those amounts from your sales reports. Filing the return is separate.

### What is the California sales tax rate?

California's statewide base sales and use tax rate is 7.25 percent. District taxes added by cities and counties make the rate you charge higher in many places, and those add-ons change. Do not copy a rate from a neighboring city. Look up the current rate for the place of sale on the CDTFA website. Glenhold records the tax you collect. This site does not assign a rate for your business.

### Does Glenhold file California sales tax returns?

No. The listed services are bookkeeping, cleanup, QuickBooks Online setup and training, and the reports that come with the monthly plans. They do not include filing sales and use tax returns. The books can show taxable sales, tax collected, and tax paid so the person who files has a trail.

### Does Glenhold file the California franchise tax?

No. Preparing and filing the Franchise Tax Board return, including the LLC return, is tax work for your CPA or other tax preparer. Glenhold keeps the bookkeeping those forms draw from: income, expenses, and reconciled balances. Your preparer confirms which form applies.

### How should estimated tax payments be recorded?

When estimated federal or California taxes are paid from a business account, the payment should be recorded. Depending on the entity it may be a draw, a distribution, or a tax payment, not an operating expense like rent. The category is a question for your CPA. Glenhold records the payment in the account you and your CPA agree on.

### Where does Glenhold provide bookkeeping services?

Glenhold is based in Simi Valley and serves small businesses in surrounding Ventura County and Los Angeles County communities within about an hour's drive, traffic permitting. Coverage includes the Conejo Valley, Camarillo, Oxnard, Ventura, the Highway 126 towns, the San Fernando Valley, Santa Clarita, Burbank, Glendale, and Malibu. Some farther trips take longer than an hour in traffic. Each city page describes that drive. This is a service area, not an office in each city.

### Which Ventura County cities does Glenhold serve?

Glenhold serves Simi Valley, Moorpark, Thousand Oaks, Newbury Park, Camarillo, Oxnard, Ventura, Port Hueneme, Santa Paula, Fillmore, and Ojai, plus nearby Oak Park. Newbury Park is part of the City of Thousand Oaks. Ojai and some Highway 126 trips often run longer than an hour. Ventura's official city name is San Buenaventura.

### Which Los Angeles areas does Glenhold serve?

Glenhold serves nearby Los Angeles County communities, including Westlake Village, Agoura Hills, Calabasas, Chatsworth, Porter Ranch, Northridge, Granada Hills, Woodland Hills, Canoga Park, Reseda, Encino, Van Nuys, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, North Hollywood, Santa Clarita, Burbank, Glendale, and Malibu. These are service-area pages, not branch offices. Glendale, Malibu, and parts of the east Valley often take an hour or more in traffic.

### Does Glenhold work remotely or in person?

Day-to-day bookkeeping is remote: statements, QuickBooks Online, email, and a monthly close. In-person meetings are available by arrangement when they help, generally within about an hour of Simi Valley. There is no published office address and no walk-in counter. Farther cities are often easier to serve remotely when traffic is heavy.

### Is there a Glenhold office I can walk into?

No. Glenhold Bookkeeping does not publish a street address and does not list walk-in hours. Call (805) 419-3451 or use the contact form. Meetings are scheduled. The monthly bookkeeping itself is done remotely.

### What should I prepare for a bookkeeping assessment?

Start with a list of your business bank and credit card accounts, the periods you need help with, the most recent completed reports, and any deadlines. Mention closed accounts, missing statements, and known issues. Ask how to share records before sending sensitive documents.

### How do I get started with Glenhold?

Book a free introductory call or send a message through the website. Explain your business, your current bookkeeping situation, and the help you need. Monthly service includes a first-month guarantee: love your first month of books, or it is free.

### Do you work with brand-new businesses?

Yes. A new business can start with QuickBooks Online setup and training, or with monthly bookkeeping once there are accounts to reconcile. The site does not list a minimum time in business. Pricing still depends on volume and complexity.

### Do you take businesses outside the one-hour service area?

Glenhold's published focus is about an hour from Simi Valley, depending on traffic. The firm is built for that region, not as a national service. If you are outside the area, say so when you write so Jack can tell you whether it is a fit.
